result.reason: The added provision reaches the preferred position: HDI presently assigns the Site deliverables to the Company, the Company owns its Content and customer/user data, HDI retains its pre-existing and generally applicable tools and know-how, and the Company receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded or operationally necessary HDI materials. It also expressly disclaims joint ownership. The amendment is confined to the ownership gap and preserves the existing approval, merchant-of-record, product-title and trademark provisions. Drafting is professional, though the data language could be slightly more comprehensive by covering all Customer Data provided to or processed by HDI, rather than only data collected through the Site.
